info.title: RelayShield Security Tools (MCP)
info.description: MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Exposes RelayShield security intelligence tools (breach, SIM-swap, infostealer, domain lookalikes, ransomware leak-site listings, LLMjacking, MCP registry risk, prompt-injection breach, and more) to AI agents. Call tools/list to discover the current tool set and each tool's per-call x402 (USDC on Base) pricing; call tools/call to invoke one. Every tool accepts optional rs_api_key / x_payment arguments so each calling agent pays for its own usage rather than sharing one operator credential.

post.description: Standard Model Context Protocol methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, notifications/initialized. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io for the full transport spec.

listTools.summary: Discover available tools and their per-call pricing

callTool.summary: Call check_llm_credential_exposure, paying with your own x402 proof

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response, as application/json or as an SSE event stream depending on the request's Accept header. A tool call needing payment (missing/invalid rs_api_key or x_payment) still returns HTTP 200 -- MCP carries that as {payment_required: true, price, payment_requirements} inside the JSON-RPC result content, not as an HTTP status code.
